name: bun
why: TypeScript runtime, package manager and test runner for this repo

name: just
why: Task runner; every check goes through the justfile

name: lefthook
why: Runs the pre-commit and pre-push git hooks in lefthook.yml

name: gitleaks
why: Secret scanning in the pre-commit hook and `just check`; the hook fails without it
install: gh release download v8.30.1 -R gitleaks/gitleaks -p 'gitleaks_8.30.1_linux_x64.tar.gz' && tar -xzf gitleaks_8.30.1_linux_x64.tar.gz gitleaks && install -m 755 gitleaks ~/.local/bin/gitleaks
